seo-manager.plugin.name: SEO Manager
seo-manager.page.title: SEO Manager
seo-manager.page.description: Manage site-wide search settings, crawler rules, redirects and canonical URLs in one place.
seo-manager.health.title: SEO Health
seo-manager.health.subtitle: First-party checks of published CMS content and the current frontend SEO configuration.
seo-manager.health.scoreNote: Informational, first-party audit — not a search ranking score.
seo-manager.health.error: SEO health could not be loaded. Check your permissions and try again.
seo-manager.health.noDataDescription: Publish SEO-enabled content to begin the audit.
seo-manager.health.emptyDescription: All checks currently run by this dashboard pass for the selected filters.
seo-manager.sitemap.title: Sitemap
seo-manager.sitemap.description: Manage which approved URL sources appear in the XML sitemap. URLs and route patterns are generated by the application.
seo-manager.sitemap.error: Sitemap diagnostics could not be loaded. Check your SEO Manager permissions and retry.
seo-manager.sitemap.routesHelp: Expand a parent route to inspect its child URLs. Route patterns are application-managed; switches only control sitemap inclusion.
seo-manager.sitemap.childSitemapsHelp: The sitemap index references only enabled groups that currently contain eligible URLs.
seo-manager.sitemap.disabled: Sitemap generation or indexing is disabled
seo-manager.sitemap.noIssues: No sitemap validation issues were found.
seo-manager.sitemap.previewLimit: Showing the first 100 URLs. Open the XML sitemap to inspect the complete list.
seo-manager.sitemap.contentTypesHelp: Turn a source off to exclude all its entries from the sitemap. Content stays published and its SEO fields are unchanged.
seo-manager.sitemap.staticRoutesHelp: Paths are read-only and managed by the application route registry.
seo-manager.sitemap.globalPolicyNote: The global sitemap switch remains in Metadata settings. Entry-level include_in_sitemap, noindex, canonical and redirect rules continue to take precedence over these source toggles.
seo-manager.sitemap.policySaveError: Sitemap policy could not be saved. Check Content Manager permissions and try again.
seo-manager.sitemap.policySaved: Sitemap policy saved and the frontend sitemap was revalidated.
seo-manager.sitemap.policySavedRevalidat: Sitemap policy was saved, but frontend revalidation failed. The existing cached sitemap remains available.
seo-manager.sitemap.revalidateError: Unable to revalidate sitemap. The existing cached sitemap remains available.
seo-manager.robots.sitemapManagedByFront: The public sitemap URL is generated from the frontend NEXT_PUBLIC_SERVER_URL environment setting.
seo-manager.redirects.title: Redirect rules
seo-manager.redirects.description: Manage permanent and temporary URL redirects.
seo-manager.canonicals.title: Canonical rules
seo-manager.canonicals.description: Set canonical URL overrides for public paths.
seo-manager.status.empty: No rules yet. Add a rule to get started.
seo-manager.error.load: SEO settings could not be loaded. Check your Content Manager permissions and try again.
seo-manager.error.save: Could not save these SEO settings. Check Content Manager permissions and try again.
seo-manager.error.rule: Could not save this rule. Verify the path and your permissions, then try again.
seo-manager.error.delete: Could not delete this SEO rule.
seo-manager.confirm.delete: Delete this SEO rule? This cannot be undone.

backup-manager.card.database.title: Database backup
backup-manager.card.full.title: Full backup
backup-manager.card.full.description: Includes the PostgreSQL database and all uploaded images and files.
backup-manager.card.uploads.title: Images and files backup
backup-manager.card.uploads.description: Includes all files in the Strapi uploads directory.
